description: This script computes differences between two system images by listing files present in one image but not the other, grouped by package, and includes functions for mapping files to packages and vendors based on JSON metadata.

methods.name: _get_relative_out_path_from_root
methods.description: Calculates the relative path from the Android root to the out directory.

methods.name: system_files
methods.description: Recursively lists all files under the /system directory, ignoring symbolic links.

methods.name: system_files_to_package_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from system files to their respective packages based on module-info.json.

methods.name: package_to_vendor_map
methods.description: Maps packages to their vendors based on module paths in module-info.json.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes two out directories, computes file differences, and outputs CSV data about the differing files.
